snippet.title: The Most Disgusting Interviewers Of Michael Jackson
snippet.description:
Throughout his career, Michael Jackson endured some of the most disrespectful, uncomfortable, and outrageous interviews imaginable. From judgmental remarks to intrusive questions and blatant attempts to provoke him, some interviewers showed little regard for the person sitting right in front of them.

What makes these moments even more remarkable is how Michael handled himself. Despite the constant disrespect, he remained composed, calm, and remarkably patient.

This video highlights some of the most disgusting interview moments Michael Jackson had to endure and the incredible restraint he displayed in the face of them.
